criteria.criterion: The service imports only reader/transport dependencies and cannot invoke old authoring, query, generic execute or profile/Task/skill mutation operations.
criteria.evidence_scope: Closed dispatch and captured loaded-module identity cover only the reader/transport closure. Initial public CLI and worker/replacement compile captured admitted bytes.

criteria.criterion: Responses carry schema/project/snapshot/scope/filter/page/effective-limits/coverage/diagnostics, unknown hasMore is null and totals label exact count scope.
criteria.evidence_scope: All six real Reader responses preserve the schema metadata and coverage contract; actual 1025-scalar qualifier map survives IPC/HTTP at 14484 bytes. Fixed errors keep unknown has_more and total null.

criteria.criterion: Installed/configured/running/readable/stale/wrong-project/unavailable are distinct health facts, independent of optional readiness sweeps.
criteria.evidence_scope: Health facts remain independent; actual stale local source stays readable, absent endpoint remains unknown, and invalid/configuration-needed cases retain fixed meanings.

criteria.criterion: Invalid Host/Origin/CSRF/session and other-service credentials disclose no project data; server fixes root and rejects browser authority/scope fields.
criteria.evidence_scope: Actual wrong host/origin/CSRF/session and cross-root credentials are rejected; fixed selected root and strict request key admission exclude browser authority fields.

criteria.criterion: Bootstrap consumes once, leaves visible URL/history before navigation and never appears in copied local links, diagnostics, test fixtures or evidence.
criteria.evidence_scope: Synchronous initial and same-document fragment replacement precedes network; actual replay returns401 on both navigation forms. OS tab and real browser clean URL are observed. This bootstrap has no copy-link UI; full later copied-link flows need their own verification.

criteria.criterion: Expiry uses fresh reader sessions and preserves safe desired context; browser never claims it restarts Python.
criteria.evidence_scope: Independent absolute sessions expire/reopen without extending lifetime. Recorded safe context remains, and new generation ignores late responses. Browser only instructs explicit local reopen and cannot restart Python.

criteria.criterion: Installed production assets include build identity, dependency lock and notices in the package; HTTP serves only runtime assets with correct MIME/no-store/nosniff/referrer/CSP protections.
criteria.evidence_scope: Real schema/lock/notices are pinned with whole-epoch static reads. Runtime-only paths have expected MIME, no-store, nosniff, no-referrer and baseline CSP; metadata stays outside HTTP.

criteria.criterion: Missing bundle returns incomplete-package error with a maintenance route; no browser launch performs npm/build/install or enables advanced profiles.
criteria.evidence_scope: Missing bundle launch returns package_incomplete and BUILD.md maintenance route. Startup has no package-manager/build/profile path.

criteria.criterion: Strict explorer configuration is optional-safe-default or explicit validated selected-project configuration; no depot IDs/labels become shared frontend constants.
criteria.evidence_scope: Absent optional explorer configuration uses bounded defaults; explicit configuration is checked against selected identity. Frontend renders real context strings; no depot identity constants.

criteria.criterion: Manifest, hashed runtime files and notices are included by the unchanged Template discovery rules; dist/build exclusions stay effective. The manifest names runtime assets only, while the lock and build instructions remain package metadata outside HTTP access.
criteria.evidence_scope: Exact unchanged discovery predicate includes final manifested assets, manifest, notices, lock and BUILD metadata and keeps dist/build/node_modules exclusions. No Template adoption is claimed.

criteria.criterion: The proposed explore --open command starts only the selected reader service and optionally opens a fresh safe bootstrap entry under explicit launch authority.
criteria.evidence_scope: Actual public CLI subprocess starts selected service. Separately, in-process verified command(... explore --open) dispatches OS browser and native existing-tab inspection confirms clean context; attribution is not conflated.

criteria.criterion: Health distinguishes installed/configured/running/readable/stale/wrong-project/unavailable without unrelated optional readiness sweeps or startup side effects.
criteria.evidence_scope: No optional sweep/listener/runtime-file health side effects. Actual trickle peer ends near2 seconds and malformed/TE/redirect peers reject; failures remain unavailable/unknown rather than proved stopped.

criteria.criterion: Service identity differs from sys4ai-ontology-workbench; health uses a bounded explicit loopback origin and never accepts a bootstrap URL.
criteria.evidence_scope: Distinct sys4ai-project-knowledge-explorer identity, numeric loopback origin grammar, bounded headers/body/overall deadline, bootstrap URL rejection, and no redirect following.

criteria.criterion: Old authoring CLI behavior is classified and preserved until qualified cutover; no documentation claims the reader can restart a stopped process from a web page.
criteria.evidence_scope: Ordinary term/search/read preserve knowledge and metadata except expected helper snapshot digest; workbench help retains authority/session flags, legacy dispatch is preserved and documentation classifies later cutover. No authoring mutation or retirement performed.
